_or_migration_hashes.reason: OWNED by the deploy workflow, owner DBA, end state decided under OR-T1252: .github/workflows/supabase-deploy.yml creates it (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plus ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, read back before use) ahead of the migration content scan and records one sha256 per migration at first apply. Deliberately NOT a migration file: the scan needs the table before the apply loop runs, and a migration exists only once that loop has applied it. No app code reads it, so it stays out of the generated type file and this waiver stays. Absent on prod until the first prod apply after that workflow change merges; created there with RLS on, no policies.
